aesthetic.summary: A flat, grid-precise, text-led internal operations interface with generous white space, small typography, sharp geometry, and no decorative UI noise.

paper-field.usage: Page background and outer workspace field.

panel-plane.usage: Panels, forms, tables, and control surfaces.

command-blue.usage: Primary commands, selected navigation, links, and focus outlines.

confirm-green.usage: Success or enabled status text only.

fault-red.usage: Failure, destructive, disabled, or disconnected status text only.

ui.purpose: All normal interface text, rows, forms, and navigation.

strong.purpose: Page titles, section names, selected items, and primary values.

label.purpose: Form labels, compact metadata, and field captions.

mono.purpose: Logs, payloads, URLs, headers, and machine-shaped values.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Small rectangular command button for the main action in a focused area.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--command-blue); border-radius: 2px; background: var(--command-blue); color: var(--panel-plane); font: 650 13px/1.5 "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--command-blue) 88%, var(--ink-strong)); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--command-blue); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Flat rectangular secondary command with the same geometry as primary.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--grid-line); border-radius: 2px; background: var(--panel-plane); color: var(--ink-base); font: 600 13px/1.5 "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--grid-line-strong); color: var(--ink-strong); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--command-blue); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Navigation Link
components.description: Slim geometric navigation item with text-led selected state.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { display: flex; align-items: center; height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 2px; color: var(--ink-base); font: 600 13px/1.5 "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-link:hover { border-color: var(--grid-line); color: var(--ink-strong); } .ds-nav-link--active { border-color: var(--grid-line-strong); color: var(--command-blue); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--command-blue); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Status Text
components.description: Inline semantic status. Use this instead of badges, chips, dots, or markers.
components.css: .ds-status-text { color: var(--ink-muted); font: 600 13px/1.5 "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-status-text--success { color: var(--confirm-green); font-weight: 650; } .ds-status-text--danger { color: var(--fault-red); font-weight: 650; }

components.name: Panel Plane
components.description: Flat working panel aligned to the 8px grid.
components.css: .ds-panel { padding: 24px; border: 1px solid var(--grid-line); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--panel-plane); color: var(--ink-base); font: 400 13px/1.5 "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-panel h2 { margin: 0 0 16px; color: var(--ink-strong); font: 650 13px/1.5 "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-panel p { margin: 0; }

components.name: Operational Field
components.description: Compact field geometry for forms and filters.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 8px; color: var(--ink-base); font: 600 13px/1.5 "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field input { height: 32px; padding: 0 8px; border: 1px solid var(--grid-line); border-radius: 2px; background: var(--panel-plane); color: var(--ink-strong); font: 400 13px/1.5 "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--command-blue); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: TaskScheduler React is a sharp minimalist control surface for internal operators. The interface should feel precise, expensive, and professional because every element is aligned, necessary, and quiet. Shape, spacing, and grid discipline are the design language. Decoration is not.
keyCharacteristics: Flat surfaces with no shadow or gradient.
Text-led status instead of badges or markers.

rules.name: The Strict Grid Rule
rules.body: All layout, control height, gaps, and panel padding must resolve to the 8px grid.

rules.name: The One Size Rule
rules.body: All UI text stays at 13px. Hierarchy comes from weight, spacing, alignment, and structure.

rules.name: The No Decoration Rule
rules.body: No hero sections, note blocks, badges, shadows, hover animation, gradients, or decorative icons.

rules.name: The Sharp Geometry Rule
rules.body: Controls use 2px radius, panels use 4px maximum, and tables may use 0px radius.

rules.name: The Necessary Text Rule
rules.body: Every word must support operation, recognition, or error prevention.

dos: Use an 8px grid and equal sibling gaps.
Use generous white space around flat panels.
Use geometric icons only when they improve recognition.
donts: Do not create note blocks or filler panels.
Do not use badges, chips, dots, counters, or attention markers.
Do not use shadows, glow, blur, glass effects, or gradients.
Do not use hover animation, movement, scaling, fading, or animated transitions.
Do not use large radius, pill buttons, pill navigation, or soft cards.
Do not use icons with rounded, cute, soft, or highly curved shapes.
